name: Advancing Front Meshing with Curvature Guidance
definition: A method for generating high-quality triangle meshes using a curvature-based guidance field.
summary: Advancing Front Meshing with Curvature Guidance is a coarse-to-fine surface extraction strategy that uses a voxel pyramid and statistical curvature thresholds to adaptively refine high-curvature regions, reducing artifacts and topological errors.
